trace.name: vibration level, P-102.BRG-1
trace.query:
WITH since AS (          -- the position's recordings since the current bearing went in
  SELECT r.recording_id, r.metadata->>'start' AS start_utc, (r.checkpoint->>'end')::bigint AS n,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY (r.metadata->>'start')::timestamptz) AS k,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY (r.metadata->>'start')::timestamptz DESC) AS back
  FROM fleet.vibration r
  WHERE r.metadata->>'equipment_id' = %(equipment_id)s
    AND (r.metadata->>'start')::timestamptz >= %(since)s::timestamptz
    AND (r.metadata->>'start')::timestamptz <= %(at)s::timestamptz
)
SELECT s.recording_id, s.start_utc, st.rms, s.k, s.back, (SELECT count(*) FROM since) AS total
FROM since s, LATERAL morlet_interval_stats('fleet.vibration', s.recording_id, 0, s.n) st
WHERE s.k <= %(baseline)s OR s.back = 1
ORDER BY s.k

result.baseline: median of the first 24 recordings from 2004-03-04T09:27:46Z

trace.name: similar recordings and the bearings behind them, P-102.BRG-3
trace.query:
WITH pos AS (            -- graph: the bearing in this position at the time, and since when it is installed
  SELECT * FROM ag_catalog.cypher('plant', $cy$
    MATCH (a:PhysicalAsset)-[i:INSTALLED_IN]->(m:EquipmentModule {equipment_id: $equipment_id})
    WHERE i.from <= $at AND (i.to IS NULL OR $at < i.to)
    RETURN a.id, a.lot, m.collection, i.from
  $cy$, %(graph_params)s) AS (asset text, lot text, collection text, installed_from text)
), query AS (            -- MorletDB: the position's latest recording at or before the time
  SELECT r.recording_id FROM fleet.vibration r, pos
  WHERE r.metadata->>'equipment_id' = %(equipment_id)s
    AND (r.metadata->>'start')::timestamptz <= %(at)s::timestamptz
    AND (r.metadata->>'start')::timestamptz >= pos.installed_from::timestamptz
  ORDER BY (r.metadata->>'start')::timestamptz DESC LIMIT 1
), installs AS (         -- graph: every bearing ever installed in a position, with its recorded failure, if any
  SELECT * FROM ag_catalog.cypher('plant', $cy$
    MATCH (a:PhysicalAsset)-[i:INSTALLED_IN]->(m:EquipmentModule)
    OPTIONAL MATCH (f:Failure)-[:OF_ASSET]->(a)
    OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(fm:FailureMode)
    RETURN m.equipment_id, a.id, a.lot, i.from, i.to, f.id, fm.id, fm.name
  $cy$, %(graph_params)s) AS (equipment_id text, asset text, lot text, installed_from text, removed text,
                             failure text, mode text, mode_name text)
)
SELECT pos.asset AS query_asset, pos.lot AS query_lot, pos.installed_from AS query_installed_from,
       q.recording_id AS query_recording, h.recording_id, h.start_sample, h.end_sample, h.distance,
       h.metadata->>'start' AS start_utc, i.equipment_id, i.asset, i.lot, i.failure, i.mode, i.mode_name
FROM pos
CROSS JOIN query q
CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.morlet_search_similar(pos.collection::regclass, q.recording_id, 0, 4096,
                                                 top_k => %(top_k)s,
                                                 time_to => pos.installed_from::timestamptz) h
LEFT JOIN installs i
  ON i.equipment_id = h.metadata->>'equipment_id'
 AND (h.metadata->>'start')::timestamptz >= i.installed_from::timestamptz
 AND (i.removed IS NULL OR (h.metadata->>'start')::timestamptz < i.removed::timestamptz)
ORDER BY h.distance, h.recording_id, h.start_sample

caveats: Similarity is evidence for a hypothesis, not a diagnosis: the closest earlier recordings came from a bearing that failed with this mode; confirming the mode needs inspection (or an envelope spectrum at the defect frequencies).
Searched: recordings made before the current bearing was installed, on the stored 4096-sample window grid; not found there is not 'never happened'.
Same lot is a shared risk factor, not evidence of a defect; unmonitored siblings have no vibration evidence either way.
The plant, its organisation, lots and work orders are fictional; the recordings and their failures are the IMS bearing data's.
